summary.name: PhotoDirector 365
summary.one_liner: CyberLink's AI-enhanced photo editor for organizing, retouching, compositing layers, and creating generative AI images and videos, with a free Essential version.
use_cases: removing distractions or backgrounds from photos
generating AI images or videos from stills
summary.what_it_does: PhotoDirector 365 is a desktop photo editor that covers organizing a photo library with face-based collections, RAW development, layer and mask compositing, and portrait retouching. It includes AI tools for enhancement (denoise, deblur, upscaling, auto color), object and background removal, and portrait reshaping. Generative features include text-to-image with selectable models, image-to-video, face swap for up to four faces, virtual outfit try-on, and an AI Photo Agent that carries out edits from plain-language requests. An AI PC Mode can run supported features locally on the PC's GPU, CPU or NPU, with cloud processing for the most demanding generative work.
notable: AI PC Mode runs supported AI locally on PC with no credits, optimized for NVIDIA RTX and Intel Core Ultra
AI Model Lab lets users pick among several third-party generative models
Layer, mask, and blend-mode compositing with RAW and batch editing
Free PhotoDirector Essential version with no time limit
caveats: Advanced AI tools and some export options are restricted in the free Essential version
Cloud generative work and video use credits
Subscription (365) or one-time 2027 license needed for full generative AI features
Page FAQ says Windows; the page also links a macOS version
